additional_vitolas.name: JFR 770 / 770 Limited Edition
additional_vitolas.notes: Sold as both a regular bundle product ('JFR Maduro 770', boxes of 30, by Casa Fernandez/Tabacalera Tropical) and marketed by some retailers as 'JFR 770 Limited Edition'. Could not confirm a distinct blend difference between plain '770' and '770-LE' - treat as the same 7x70 vitola with 'LE' likely reflecting retailer marketing language rather than a confirmed separate release.
